AI: Thanks for calling Bayside Dental, this is Ava. How can I help?

AI: Sure. Can I get your name and a phone number?
User: Sam Rivera, 555-0142.
AI: Got it. I have you down for a cleaning next Tuesday at 10 AM under Sam Rivera, 555-0142. Does that look right?
User: Yes, perfect.
AI: You're all set. We'll send a reminder the day before. Anything else?
User: No, thanks. Bye.
AI: Goodbye!
